stations.title: Idris
stations.say: Count the orders, the easy way.

stations.title: The morning note
stations.text: Three commands copied by hand, every day.
stations.note: One wrong letter, a wrong count.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, Idris counts the orders each morning with three long commands.
They are copied by hand from a note, and one wrong letter gives a wrong count.
You write the reader of the tool's words: command, values and flags, in three tasks.
Now orders knows what Idris typed, and says plainly when a flag is wrong.
Same shop, same morning, and the first part of a tool anyone can run.
